title: Sil Fighter
description: 2D platform fighter in the style of Smash Bros — and every character is Sil, the older brother of Mees! Pummel your rival off the stage with jabs, tackles, and uppercuts in 2-player local battles or vs a sneaky AI.
controls: P1: A/D move · W jump · F attack · G special · S shield | P2: ←/→ move · ↑ jump · L attack · K special · ↓ shield | Menus: WASD/Arrows + F/L/Enter to confirm
